name: Buta Hime-sama
source:
Istwalle. A small nation of dairy and agriculture, mainly fruit farming.
It was a happy and tranquil place...

... until the orcs attacked.

The orcs were an invasion decreed by rival kingdom Dolvanas.
Their mission was twofold: 1) to seize all abundant resources, and
2) to marry Istwalle's beautiful princess Ilena to King Dolum.

To spare her people, princess Ilena surrendered to her fate.
She had no idea how incredibly obscene it would be... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE073416.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
伊斯特瓦尔，一个以奶业与农业，尤其是水果种植为主的小国。
这里原本幸福而宁静……

……直到兽人来袭。

兽人的侵略由敌对王国多尔瓦纳斯下令发动。
他们的任务有二：一是夺取一切丰饶的资源；二是把伊斯特瓦尔美丽的伊莲娜公主嫁给多鲁姆王。

为了保护人民，伊莲娜公主屈从于自己的命运。
她完全没有想到，那里的生活竟会如此淫靡……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE073416.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
